title: Sportbladet söker videoreporter – inhoppare till tv och sociala medier
description:
Vill du vara mitt i sportens nyhetspuls och producera journalistik som varje vecka når miljontals svenskar? Sportbladet är Sveriges största sportdestination – och vi söker nu en inhoppande video- och some-reporter som brinner för snabb, träffsäker och engagerande journalistik.

På Sportbladet jobbar ett trettiotal medarbetare och ett stort antal frilansare. Vi når över 1,5 miljoner svenskar varje dag med vår journalistik och vi hanterar allt ifrån breaking news, reportage, intervjuer, sociala medier, poddar, radio och tv. Vi livesänder också sport som bland annat internationell fotboll, nationell ishockey och massa annat.

Som video- och some-reporter är du en nyckelspelare i vår journalistik. Du kan snabbt klippa video, göra starka intervjuer och rapportera från fältet vid stora nyhetshändelser. Du har god omvärldskoll, ett vaket nyhetsöga och förmåga att själv identifiera vinklar och nyheter.

I uppdraget ingår att skapa och redigera rörligt innehåll som kan publiceras både i sociala kanaler och på Aftonbladets sajt. Det kan handla om att identifiera och ta fram egna nyheter, och att förpacka redan existerande material. Du känner dig också trygg framför kameran och kan spela in video från fältet såväl som på redaktionen.

Du har god förståelse för sociala medier, olika målgruppers användarvanor och vad som engagerar på olika plattformar. Du vet hur innehåll behöver anpassas för att nå ut och har ett intresse för att hitta nya sätt att berätta och nå nya, inte minst yngre, målgrupper.

Sportbladet vill vara bäst på bevakningen av fotboll, ishockey och vintersport. Därför är det viktigt att du kan bidra på redaktionen med din kunskap inom dessa områden. Vi söker dig som tycker om att berätta, förstår vad som kan bli bra och engagerande innehåll och är duktig på att ställa om snabbt.

Kvalifikationer:

  • Erfarenhet av journalistiskt arbete på en nyhetsredaktion, gärna på en sportredaktion

  • Mycket goda sportkunskaper

  • Erfarenhet av videojournalistik och stor förståelse för effektivt berättande i video

  • Goda redigeringskunskaper i Premiere Pro

  • Erfarenhet av att medverka i livesändningar

  • Kunskap om bildsättning och bildrättigheter

  • God förståelse för sociala medier, olika plattformars möjligheter och målgruppernas användarvanor

  • Goda publicistiska kunskaper och stark etisk kompetens

  • Journalistutbildning eller motsvarande erfarenhet som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig

Meriterande:

  • Kunskaper i program som After Effects och Photoshop

  • Erfarenhet av att producera journalistiskt innehåll för sociala medier och nå nya målgrupper

  • Brett kontaktnät inom sport

Vad erbjuder vi dig?

  • En stimulerande arbetsplats där du når en miljonpublik

  • Kunniga, smarta och drivna kollegor och en trevlig arbetsmiljö

  • Krävande och erfarna chefer som får dig att utvecklas varje dag

  • Engagerad publik som hjälper oss att bli bättre

Villkor:

Tjänsten är en timanställning som vikarie vid behov. Arbetstid både dag- och kvällstid samt helger kan förekomma.

Vi jobbar med löpande rekrytering vilket innebär att tjänsten kan bli tillsatt innan sista ansökningsdatum.

Har du frågor om tjänsten, kontakta [namn och kontaktuppgifter].

För fackliga frågor, kontakta Cecilia Vaccari (SJF): cecilia.vaccari@aftonbladet.se

Välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Utvecklingschef till Podme
description:
Är du en kreativ ledare med fingertoppskänsla för innehåll, storytelling och publik? Vill du vara med och utveckla framtidens poddar på ett av Nordens största mediebolag?

På Podme hittar du några av Sveriges mest populära poddar, som Ursäkta, Rättegångspodden, Podme Dokumentär och Alex & Sigges podcast. Vi satsar både på starka profildrivna format och dokumentärt berättande, med ambitionen att skapa innehåll som engagerar, berör och får lyssnarna att komma tillbaka.

Vi söker nu en utvecklingschef som vill ta en nyckelroll i arbetet med att utveckla framtidens podcastformat, i både ljud och video, och ytterligare stärka Podmes position på marknaden.

Om tjänsten

Som utvecklingschef på Podme ansvarar du för att driva och utveckla nya podcastkoncept och format, från den första idén till pitch och pilotproduktion. Du har en central roll i vårt kreativa utvecklingsarbete och arbetar både strategiskt och operativt för att säkerställa att våra produktioner håller hög kvalitet och når våra kreativa och kommersiella mål.

Du har ett övergripande perspektiv på utvecklingen av nya produktioner och arbetar nära exekutiva producenter, kreatörer och externa samarbetspartners. Du leder själv utvalda utvecklingsprojekt och fungerar som kreativt bollplank och rådgivare i andra.

I takt med att video blir en del av Podmes erbjudande får du också vara med och utveckla hur vi skapar starka podcastupplevelser i både ljud och bild.

En viktig del av uppdraget är att utveckla och stärka samarbetet med övriga bolag inom Schibsted. Du får en nyckelroll i att identifiera gemensamma innehållsmöjligheter, initiera samarbeten och utveckla nya format där vi kan dra nytta av den samlade journalistiska och kreativa kompetensen inom koncernen.

I rollen ingår även personalansvar för producenter och ljudtekniker. Du ansvarar för att leda och utveckla teamet samt skapa goda förutsättningar för kreativitet, samarbete och hög kvalitet i våra produktioner.

Du rapporterar till Moa Soltanian Magnusson, Head of Content.

Dina ansvarsområden

  • Identifiera, utveckla och driva nya podcastkoncept och format i linje med Podmes innehållsstrategi och affärsmål.

  • Leda kreativa utvecklingsprocesser från idé till pitch och pilotproduktion.

  • Ha ett övergripande perspektiv på utvecklingen av nya podcasts och stötta exekutiva producenter i deras utvecklingsarbete.

  • Driva och utveckla innehållssamarbeten med övriga Schibstedbolag, identifiera gemensamma möjligheter och omsätta dem till nya podcastformat och produktioner.

  • Arbeta nära kreatörer, producenter och externa samarbetspartners för att utveckla innehåll med hög kvalitet och stark publikpotential.

  • Följa trender, analysera lyssnarbeteenden och identifiera nya möjligheter på podcastmarknaden.

  • Säkerställa att utvecklingsprojekten bidrar till Podmes kreativa, strategiska och kommersiella mål.

  • Ha personalansvar för producenter och ljudtekniker, inklusive arbetsledning, coachning och kompetensutveckling.

  • Ansvara för resursplanering, frilansbemanning och tillhörande budget.

Vi söker dig som

  • Har gedigen erfarenhet av att utveckla och lansera innehåll inom podcast, tv eller annan medieverksamhet.

  • Har dokumenterad erfarenhet av framgångsrik koncept- och formatutveckling och förmåga att identifiera idéer med stor publikpotential.

  • Har en mycket god känsla för storytelling, dramaturgi och vad som gör ett innehåll relevant och engagerande för sin publik.

  • Har erfarenhet av att leda kreativa processer och omsätta idéer till framgångsrika produktioner.

  • Har god förståelse för medielandskapet och förmåga att kombinera kreativ utveckling med affärsmässiga mål.

  • Har erfarenhet av ledarskap och förmåga att inspirera, coacha och utveckla andra.

  • Har lätt för att bygga relationer och driva samarbeten över organisationsgränser.

  • Är strukturerad, lösningsorienterad och van att driva flera projekt parallellt.

  • Har en journalistisk utbildning, eller motsvarande.

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av att utveckla eller producera videopoddar och har förståelse för hur innehåll och berättande kan anpassas för både ljud och bild.

Som person är du nyfiken, idérik och prestigelös. Du vågar tänka nytt, har ett starkt kreativt driv och förståelse för vilka poddar som kan flyga kommersiellt. Du är en trygg ledare som får människor omkring dig att växa och som förstår värdet av att kombinera kreativ frihet med tydliga mål.

Vi erbjuder

Som utvecklingschef på Podme blir du en del av vårt innehållsteam, som består av exekutiva producenter, producenter och ljudtekniker. Du får en central roll i ett företag med ambitionen att forma den nordiska podcastmarknaden och möjlighet att påverka vilket innehåll vi utvecklar framåt.

Du får arbeta med några av Sveriges mest profilerade podcastkreatörer och vara med och utveckla helt nya format.

Genom vårt nära samarbete med andra Schibstedbolag, som Aftonbladet, Tv4 och Svenska Dagbladet, får du också möjlighet att utveckla innehåll i mötet mellan olika redaktioner.

Vi erbjuder en kreativ arbetsmiljö med högt tempo, engagerade kollegor och stort utrymme för nya idéer. Här får du möjlighet att kombinera ditt intresse för innehåll och berättande med ett strategiskt ansvar och ett ledarskap som gör skillnad.

Vi sitter i fina, nyrenoverade lokaler på Kungsbron i Stockholm, vi har även ett högklassigt gym och en mängd andra förmåner.

Om Podme

Podme grundades 2017 i Sverige och har sedan dess vuxit till en nordisk podcastaktör med verksamhet i Sverige, Norge och Finland. Sedan 2021 är Podme en del av Schibsted. Vår ambition är att erbjuda lyssnarna marknadens bästa podcastupplevelse genom starka berättelser, engagerande profiler och innehåll av högsta kvalitet.

Ansökan

Skicka din ansökan med CV och personligt brev.

Vi läser ansökningar löpande, så vänta inte med din ansökan!

Anställningsform: Tillsvidare

Tillträde: Januari 2027 eller enligt överrenskommelse.

title: Kommersiell innehållsproducent (vik)
description:
Gillar du att skriva innehåll som engagerar samtidigt som du är nyfiken på vad som får läsaren att klicka och agera?

Nu söker vi en vikarie som kommersiell innehållsproducent till Schibsted Affiliate och E-commerce-team. Här får du kombinera skrivande med data och affärsförståelse för att skapa innehåll som hjälper våra läsare att hitta rätt produkter och samtidigt bidrar till att utveckla vår affiliateaffär.

Om rollen

Som kommersiell innehållsproducent blir du en viktig del av vårt Affiliate- och E-commerce-team. Du kommer att arbeta med innehåll inom flera olika ämnen från privatekonomi och teknik till inredning och mode. Det här är en roll där du får kombinera kreativitet med ett analytiskt arbetssätt.

Du kommer bland annat att:

  • Skapa engagerande och målgruppsanpassat kommersiellt innehåll som hjälper läsarna att fatta välgrundade köpbeslut.

  • Identifiera trender, aktuella ämnen och nya möjligheter till relevanta vinklar.

  • Följa upp och analysera hur dina texter presterar utifrån exempelvis trafik, engagemang och konvertering.

  • Omsätta insikter från olika analys- och uppföljningsverktyg för att optimera befintligt innehåll och komma på nya idéer.

  • Samarbeta med teamet för att tillsammans utveckla både innehåll och den kommersiella affären.

Vem är du?

Vi söker dig som har en bra känsla för text och tycker om att skapa innehåll som både engagerar och fyller ett tydligt syfte, oavsett ämne. Du är en skicklig skribent som kan anpassa ditt språk, tonalitet och innehåll efter målgrupp.
Samtidigt är du nyfiken på att ta reda på vad som händer med ditt material efter publicering, vad läsarna är intresserade av och få nya idéer som kan ta ditt innehåll vidare. Du tycker om att hitta nya vinklar, skapa innehåll som engagerar och förstå vad som faktiskt fungerar.

Vi tror att du har:

  • Erfarenhet av att producera och publicera engagerande innehåll för digitala kanaler.

  • Förmåga att skriva tydliga, målgruppsanpassade och kommersiellt relevanta texter.

  • Erfarenhet av att följa upp innehåll eller kampanjer och omsätta data till konkreta förbättringar.

  • Kunskaper i bildredigering.

  • Erfarenhet av digitala och AI-baserade verktyg för kreativ produktion

  • Förmåga att planera, prioritera och leverera innehåll med god kvalitet även när tempot är högt.

Det är också ett plus om du har erfarenhet av:

  • Affiliate marketing, e-handel eller annan kommersiell innehållsproduktion.

Du behöver inte ha erfarenhet av allt, men oavsett varifrån din erfarenhet kommer ifrån så tror vi att du kan skapa innehåll professionellt. Du kan ha jobbat med kommunikation, journalistik, content marketing, byrå, produktion, sociala medier eller annan kreativ miljö. Det viktigaste för oss är vad du kan göra, hur du arbetar och vad du kan bidra med till teamet.

Vilka är vi?

Vi är ett datadrivet team på fyra personer med olika bakgrunder inom journalistik och kommunikation.

Hos oss får du arbeta med varierande ämnen och kombinera kreativ innehållsproduktion med kommersiell utveckling. Du blir en del av ett mindre team där samarbete, idéer och nyfikenhet är viktiga delar av vardagen.

Arbetet är förlagt måndag–fredag, med möjlighet att arbeta på distans på fredagar.

Placering: Stockholm

Vikariatets längd: fram till januari 2028

Tillträde: Snarast möjligt

Har du frågor om tjänsten, kontakta Ida Gustafsson, Innehållschef Affiliate och E-commerce, ida.gustafsson@schibsted.com

För fackliga frågor kontakta Helena Johansson på Unionen, helena.johansson@schibsted.com

Om Schibsted

Schibsted är den största nyhetsleverantören i Norden, med varumärken som VG, Aftonbladet, TV4, MTV, Aftenposten, Svenska Dagbladet och Podme. Varje dag informerar, engagerar och underhåller vi miljoner människor i Sverige, Norge och Finland.

Sedan 1839 har tillit varit vår viktigaste grundsten. Vår journalistik ger människor insikt och inflytande, bygger gemenskaper och stärker demokratier – och med innovation och nytänkande säkerställer vi att vi lever upp till vår mission:

Our democracies depend on independent journalism. That’s our business.

title: Editorial Developer, Schibsted Product Lab
description:
We’re building the next generation of Schibsted’s media products

Schibsted’s product ambition is to reinvent our media destinations for the AI era to make our journalism a relevant daily habit for more people. Most of that work happens in our existing product organisation, where we continuously improve and reinvent products used by millions of people every day. But some opportunities require something different: more freedom from today’s products and business models, longer horizons, greater uncertainty and permission to challenge the core.

That's why we're setting up Schibsted Product Lab.

Product Lab is a small, autonomous product environment that builds, launches and tests the next generation of Schibsted’s media products with real users. We start small, increase investment as evidence grows, stop ideas that do not prove themselves, and help successful products become part of, or reshape, Schibsted’s core.

We are now looking for an Editorial Developer to join the Product Lab core team!

How we want to work

Our ambition is to make Product Lab an AI-enabled, high-velocity product environment where we can move from idea to execution at high speed. We want to push the boundaries of how emerging technologies can transform the way we discover, design and build products, equipping small teams with the tools and capabilities to turn ambitious ideas into real user experiences in days rather than months. We embrace experimentation, challenge established ways of working and prioritise learning over perfection. And we see the ability to confidently stop an idea that doesn't work as just as important as knowing when to invest further.

The role and mission

As Editorial Developer in Product Lab, you will work at the intersection of journalism, technology, product and design to explore what the next generation of media destinations could look like.

You will combine deep editorial understanding with technical curiosity and hands-on experimentation, turning emerging technologies, changing user behaviours and new ideas into concrete editorial experiences.

This is a role tasked with challenging assumptions about how journalism works, exploring entirely new ways of bringing journalistic value to people, and making those possibilities real enough to test.

You will be part of Product Lab's small permanent core team, working across early-stage initiatives alongside product managers, designers, engineers and colleagues from Schibsted's editorial organisations.

What you will do

  • Identify new editorial opportunities, exploring how emerging technologies and changing user behaviours could transform how journalism is created, distributed and experienced.

  • Develop, prototype and test new editorial concepts, working hands-on with Product, UX and Tech to turn ideas into tangible experiments with real users.

  • Define the editorial logic of new products, including what information they provide, how it is selected, produced or transformed, and how humans and AI systems collaborate.

  • Shape editorial quality and principles, navigating questions of accuracy, trust, transparency, accountability and editorial independence in new product concepts.

  • Assess editorial and operational feasibility, identifying the capabilities, workflows, resources and organisational changes needed to bring promising concepts to life.

  • Connect Product Lab with Schibsted's editorial environments, bringing relevant newsroom expertise into initiatives and helping promising concepts find pathways into existing brands and organisations.

Who we are looking for

We are looking for someone who combines strong journalistic understanding, technical fluency and a genuine drive to build what comes next.

You might come from editorial development, digital journalism, newsroom innovation, interactive storytelling, editorial product development or a related field. Your exact background matters less than your ability to move between journalistic ideas, technological possibilities and practical experimentation.

You are equally comfortable discussing editorial principles with an editor, exploring technical possibilities with a developer and making something tangible enough to test with users.

We believe you need to bring:

  • Deep understanding of journalism and editorial environments, including hands-on experience with editorial decision-making, journalistic methods and newsroom workflows.

  • Experience developing and testing digital editorial products, formats or experiences, with a user-oriented approach to turning ideas into tangible solutions and learning from feedback.

  • Technical fluency and hands-on prototyping skills, with the ability to independently build, configure or experiment with digital solutions using code, AI tools, low-code platforms or other relevant technologies.

  • Strong understanding of AI and emerging technologies, combined with curiosity about how they could reshape journalism, editorial workflows and audience experiences.

  • Experience working across editorial, product and technology disciplines, translating between different perspectives and driving ideas forward in cross-functional teams.

Experience with AI-native products, editorial automation, data journalism, interactive storytelling or emerging distribution environments will be particularly valuable.

Beyond your experience, we believe how you approach the work matters just as much. You are curious, resourceful and comfortable with uncertainty. You enjoy making things rather than only discussing them, and you know when to build something yourself and when to bring in others. You are collaborative, pragmatic and willing to challenge established assumptions.

Most importantly, you are editorially grounded without being bound to traditional formats or ways of working. You care deeply about journalism and its role in society, but you are excited to question how it should be created and experienced in the future.

Why join us

  • You help build something new from the start. You join the Lab's first core team and shape how it works and what its culture becomes.

  • You build on things a start-up has to earn first. Trusted brands, our journalism, our data and millions of users.

  • Your work reaches real users. We launch to learn, and products that work have a path into VG, Aftonbladet and our other brands.

  • You get room to work and clear decisions. The Lab works outside today's roadmaps and KPIs, and every idea gets a clear decision at set points.

  • You work on what's changing in media. AI is changing how people find and use journalism, and young people are forming their habits outside traditional news sites. You help decide what Schibsted's answer looks like.

About Schibsted

Schibsted is the largest news provider in the Nordics, with brands such as VG, Aftonbladet, TV4, MTV, Aftenposten, Svenska Dagbladet, and Podme. Every day we inform, engage, and entertain millions of people across Sweden, Norway, and Finland.

Since 1839, trust has been our foundation. Our journalism empowers people, builds communities, and strengthens democracy – and innovation ensures we continue to protect that mission.

Our democracies depend on independent journalism. That’s our business.

title: Senior Product Manager, Schibsted Product Lab
description:

The role and mission

As Senior Product Manager in Schibsted Product Lab, you will lead the development of new product ideas that could shape the future of our media destinations. You will take promising opportunities from early hypotheses to tangible products, working with small, cross-functional teams to build, launch and test new experiences with real users.

Unlike traditional product management roles focused on established products, this role is about discovering what we should build next and finding out whether it deserves to exist. You will operate in an environment where the problems are not always well-defined, the solutions are uncertain, and the goal is to generate evidence quickly enough to make confident decisions.

You will take product ownership of assigned initiatives, from early-stage seeds to more developed bets. Working closely with the Director of Product Lab and specialists in UX, technology and editorial development, you will turn opportunities into clear product propositions, drive day-to-day product decisions and help determine which ideas should progress, pivot or stop.

What you will do

  • Lead product development within assigned initiatives, taking ownership of product direction, priorities and decisions from early exploration through prototyping, testing and validation.

  • Turn opportunities into testable product propositions, framing user problems, defining hypotheses and identifying the most critical assumptions to validate.

  • Design and prioritise experiments, determining what needs to be researched, built or tested to generate meaningful evidence and reduce uncertainty.

  • Drive cross-functional seed teams, aligning design, technology, editorial and commercial perspectives around clear objectives, priorities and next steps.

  • Assess product potential and viability, combining user insights, market understanding, technical feasibility and business considerations to evaluate opportunities.

  • Translate learning into recommendations, making evidence-based proposals on whether to continue, pivot, scale or stop initiatives, and identifying new opportunities worth exploring.

Who we are looking for

We are looking for an experienced, entrepreneurial product manager who thrives at the intersection of strategy, discovery and hands-on product development. You enjoy turning ambiguity into action, are comfortable making decisions with incomplete information, and know how to balance ambitious thinking with pragmatic experimentation.

You are as interested in discovering what users might need tomorrow as you are in building something they can use today. You know when to explore broadly, when to narrow the focus, and when there is enough evidence to make a decision.

We believe you need to bring:

  • Strong experience in digital/AI product management, including ownership of product direction, prioritisation and delivery in cross-functional teams.

  • Demonstrated ability to take new product ideas from opportunity to validation, using product discovery, hypothesis-driven development, prototyping and experimentation.

  • Excellent product judgement and analytical skills, with the ability to assess user desirability, business viability and technical feasibility, and make decisions under uncertainty.

  • Strong understanding of users, markets and emerging behaviours, and the ability to translate insights into differentiated product opportunities.

  • The ability to lead and mobilise cross-functional teams, bringing together different disciplines and driving progress without relying on formal authority.

  • A hands-on, entrepreneurial mindset, combining strategic thinking with a willingness to build, test, learn and change direction quickly.

Experience working with emerging technologies, AI-enabled products or new digital media experiences is particularly valuable, as is an understanding of the changing ways people discover, consume and interact with journalism.

Why join us

  • You help build something new from the start. You join the Lab's first core team and shape how it works and what its culture becomes.

  • You build on things a start-up has to earn first. Trusted brands, our journalism, our data and millions of users.

  • Your work reaches real users. We launch to learn, and products that work have a path into VG, Aftonbladet and our other brands.

  • You get room to work and clear decisions. The Lab works outside today's roadmaps and KPIs, and every idea gets a clear decision at set points.

  • You work on what's changing in media. AI is changing how people find and use journalism, and young people are forming their habits outside traditional news sites. You help decide what Schibsted's answer looks like.

That also means you drive your own work and your own learning. You're part of the core team led by the Director of Product Lab, and you report directly to the Director of Technology in Schibsted's Product organisation.

The role grows with the Lab. You start with no direct reports and your hands in the code. As Product Lab grows, you'll also help shape how we build technical teams around successful bets, and strengthen the engineering craft and culture of the Lab. Over time, that can include people management.

What you will do

  • Assess new product ideas quickly for technical feasibility, cost and risk, and give a clear recommendation to stop, continue or scale them.

  • Build and ship early prototypes and experiments, using whatever mix of code, AI tools, APIs and Schibsted platforms gets us to real user learning fastest.

  • Build new product experiences with AI at the core, using language models, agents and retrieval over our journalism, rather than adding AI to the products we already have.

  • Make architecture and technology choices that fit how mature each idea is, and know what a scrappy prototype needs to become a solid, scalable product.

  • Work closely with product, design and editorial colleagues, and connect Lab ideas with the engineering, data, AI and platform teams across Schibsted.

  • Coach the engineers who join our teams, many of them for a few weeks or months from other parts of Schibsted, so they take new skills back to their own teams.

Who we are looking for

You're a product-minded engineer and builder who thrives at the earliest and most uncertain stage of a product. You enjoy finding out whether something can be built, finding the fastest credible way to test it, and moving on once the important questions have answers.

You're pragmatic rather than precious about technology. Sometimes the right answer is solid engineering. Sometimes it's an API, an AI-generated prototype, or something held together just well enough to test an idea. You know the difference, and you know when it's time to rebuild. So this isn't a role for someone who wants to build everything from scratch, or to optimise for production quality from day one.

We believe you bring

  • Significant experience building digital and AI products as a software engineer, tech lead or similar senior role, and you're still strongly hands-on.

  • Hands-on experience building on AI models. You've shipped products or features built on language models, such as agents, retrieval or generated content. You know how to measure whether the output is good enough, and what it costs to run.

  • Broad technical skills across front end, back end, APIs and data, so you can build a whole prototype yourself.

  • An AI-native way of working. Coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor or Codex are part of how you build every day. You can show us how you use them, where they help and where they don't.

  • Experience taking products from prototype to production, with the judgement to make pragmatic trade-offs when information is limited.

  • A track record of stopping things. You've recommended stopping a feature, a system or a product you believed in when the evidence went against it. And you can tell us how you did it.

  • Technical leadership and coaching. You bring people together around a problem and give engineers direction without formal authority. You've coached other engineers and helped them grow. You'd like to grow into broader leadership as the Lab grows.

  • Ownership of your own work and growth. You keep your skills current without anyone senior to guide you, and you find your own sparring partners, inside Schibsted and outside.

Why join us

  • You help build something new from the start. You join the Lab's first core team and shape how it works and what its culture becomes.

  • You build on things a start-up has to earn first. Trusted brands, our journalism, our data and millions of users.

  • Your work reaches real users. We launch to learn, and products that work have a path into VG, Aftonbladet and our other brands.

  • You get room to work and clear decisions. The Lab works outside today's roadmaps and KPIs, and every idea gets a clear decision at set points.

  • You work on what's changing in media. AI is changing how people find and use journalism, and young people are forming their habits outside traditional news sites. You help decide what Schibsted's answer looks like.

About Schibsted

Schibsted is the largest news provider in the Nordics, with brands such as VG, Aftonbladet, TV4, MTV, Aftenposten, Svenska Dagbladet, and Podme. Every day we inform, engage, and entertain millions of people across Sweden, Norway, and Finland.

Since 1839, trust has been our foundation. Our journalism empowers people, builds communities, and strengthens democracy – and innovation ensures we continue to protect that mission.

Our democracies depend on independent journalism. That’s our business.

title: UX Lead, Schibsted Product Lab
description:
We’re building the next generation of Schibsted’s media products

Schibsted’s product ambition is to reinvent our media destinations for the AI era to make our journalism a relevant daily habit for more people. Most of that work happens in our existing product organisation, where we continuously improve and reinvent products used by millions of people every day. But some opportunities require something different: more freedom from today’s products and business models, longer horizons, greater uncertainty and permission to challenge the core.

That's why we're setting up Schibsted Product Lab.

Product Lab is a small, autonomous product environment that builds, launches and tests the next generation of Schibsted’s media products with real users. We start small, increase investment as evidence grows, stop ideas that do not prove themselves, and help successful products become part of, or reshape, Schibsted’s core.

We are now looking for an UX Lead to join the Product Lab core team!

How we want to work

Our ambition is to make Product Lab an AI-enabled, high-velocity product environment where we can move from idea to execution at high speed. We want to push the boundaries of how emerging technologies can transform the way we discover, design and build products, equipping small teams with the tools and capabilities to turn ambitious ideas into real user experiences in days rather than months. We embrace experimentation, challenge established ways of working and prioritise learning over perfection. And we see the ability to confidently stop an idea that doesn't work as just as important as knowing when to invest further.

The role and mission

The UX Lead is a senior, hands-on role responsible for ensuring that user insight and real-world evidence shape what Product Lab chooses to build and invest in.

Working across Product Lab's portfolio – from early exploration and ideas to seeds and bets – you will explore emerging behaviours and unmet needs, make new product opportunities tangible through concepts and prototypes, and rapidly test them with real users. You will move fluidly between research, concept development, interaction design, prototyping and experimentation – often before the problem or solution is well defined.

You will work closely with the core team of Product Lab, including specialists in product management, technology and editorial development, to help answer three key questions: Is there something meaningful here? What could it become? What evidence do we need before investing further?

What you will do

  • Shape how Product Lab does discovery. Set a high bar for research and experience design, and build lightweight ways of working that get ideas from uncertainty to evidence fast, without extra process.

  • Understand changing audiences. Combine user research, behavioural signals and market developments to see how people's needs and expectations around news and media are shifting, and where new products could fit.

  • Frame opportunities. Work with product, technology and editorial colleagues to turn broad questions and signals into clear user problems and testable hypotheses.

  • Prototype and experiment. Turn hypotheses into prototypes and experiments you can put in front of real users quickly, from simple provocations to live product tests.

  • Build the evidence and take seeds further. Find the assumptions that matter most, test them, and bring the evidence into decisions about whether to stop, iterate, pivot or invest. Help seeds that earn their place grow into coherent, distinctive products, and keep discovery going as they mature.

  • Lead and coach. Coach and give design and discovery direction to UX designers in temporary seeds and bets. You lead through craft and expertise, not formal authority.

  • Share learnings. Help make sure that what is learned through Product Lab initiatives is shared with the broader Schibsted organisation.

Who we are looking for

You are an experienced product designer who is comfortable operating before there is a roadmap, requirements or even a clearly defined problem. You combine strong product and interaction design skills with curiosity about people, technology and emerging behaviours.

You prototype to learn, not just to communicate. You are comfortable discarding your own ideas when the evidence points elsewhere, and you can move between strategic questions and making something concrete in the same week.

We believe you need to bring:

  • Strong exploratory and evaluative user research, including interpreting behavioural evidence.

  • Strong product and interaction design, shown in concepts you have taken from idea to validation.

  • Fast prototyping at the right fidelity, including with AI-assisted tools.

  • Good product judgement and the ability to synthesise ambiguous information into a clear point of view.

  • Experience working closely with product, technology and other disciplines.

  • The confidence to challenge assumptions, including your own, when the evidence points elsewhere.

Experience with AI-enabled products and the media industry is highly valuable, but more important is the ability to make uncertain opportunities tangible, testable and progressively less uncertain.

Why join us

  • You help build something new from the start. You join the Lab's first core team and shape how it works and what its culture becomes.

  • You build on things a start-up has to earn first. Trusted brands, our journalism, our data and millions of users.

  • Your work reaches real users. We launch to learn, and products that work have a path into Aftonbladet, VG, Aftenposten and our other brands.

  • You get room to work and clear decisions. The Lab works outside today's roadmaps and KPIs, and every idea gets a clear decision at set points.

  • You work on what's changing in media. AI is changing how people find and use journalism, and young people are forming their habits outside traditional news sites. You help decide what Schibsted's answer looks like.

About Schibsted

Schibsted is the largest news provider in the Nordics, with brands such as VG, Aftonbladet, TV4, MTV, Aftenposten, Svenska Dagbladet, and Podme. Every day we inform, engage, and entertain millions of people across Sweden, Norway, and Finland.

Since 1839, trust has been our foundation. Our journalism empowers people, builds communities, and strengthens democracy – and innovation ensures we continue to protect that mission.

Our democracies depend on independent journalism. That’s our business.

title: Data Scientist – Subscription Data Enablement
description:
Our paywall is a model. Come and make it smarter.

Schibsted | Oslo, Bergen or Stockholm (hybrid)

We built our own dynamic paywall and offer engine. Now we need to make it better, understand what works, and bring it to more brands.

We're looking for a Data Scientist who enjoys building models, testing ideas and finding out whether the results actually make a difference. You'll work alongside experienced data scientists, analysts and engineers, with opportunities to take ownership of your work and grow your skills along the way.

Why this work matters

Our democracies depend on independent journalism, and that is our business. Independent journalism needs readers who choose to pay for it.

Our job in Subscription Data Enablement is to understand those readers well enough to offer them the right thing at the right time, and to leave them alone when we shouldn't bother them.

Direct relationships with readers and digital profitability are how Schibsted measures success. Your models sit right in the middle of both.

Who we are

We are the data and analytics team for Schibsted's Subscription business in Norway and Sweden: analysts, data engineers, an ML engineer and data scientists.

We work with brands such as VG, Aftenposten, Aftonbladet, Svenska Dagbladet, Bergens Tidende and E24. Our models already cover churn, renewal, segmentation and engagement. The dynamic paywall and offer engine is the newest addition to the family.

It is also a good test of how we work. The Dynamic Paywall project has many moving parts and competing priorities, and it needs people from data, product, tech, business and editorial teams in the same room.

A consultant who recently worked with us said that, despite technically being a consultant, they "never really felt like one". They described a team where everyone brings different expertise, ideas get challenged, debates are healthy, and we don't always agree, but there is "always mutual respect" and a shared goal of finding the best way forward.

We want you to feel the same way about us a year from now.

What you will do

  • Make our paywall smarter. Develop and improve the models behind our dynamic paywall and offers: who sees which offer, and when. Propensity, recommender and offer optimisation problems are all in scope.

  • Find out what works. Design, run and analyse experiments with our brands, and report the results as they are, including what they don’t prove. Uplift modelling and causal inference are welcome tools here.

  • Build models that get used. Take models from notebook to production with our data scientists and engineers: feature engineering, training, evaluation, testing, and monitoring once they’re live. We work with tools such as Snowflake, MLflow and Streamlit.

  • Make the results understandable. Explain findings to commercial colleagues with clear analysis and dashboards where they help.

  • Improve how we work. Bring ideas on modelling, tooling and MLOps as more brands come on board, including how AI can make our own work easier.

  • Ask good questions. Including “does this actually make us money?” when someone needs to.

What you bring

  • Python or R and SQL, used to analyse data and build models.

  • Hands-on experience developing and evaluating machine learning models, and an understanding of what it takes to run them in production.

  • A solid foundation in statistics and experimentation, including hypothesis testing and A/B tests.

  • The ability to explain your work to people who don’t speak ML, and the curiosity to learn from people who know the business better than you do.

How we work

We follow a short list of team principles, and we mean them: be curious and keep learning, deliver quality together, design collaboratively, help early and ask early, share generously, have fun and stay open.

In practice, that means Show n Tell and Friday data talks every other week, a monthly hack day, and an expectation that you ask for help before you’re stuck, not after. We also encourage sitting in on newsroom meetings. It’s hard to build a good model of what readers value without knowing what the newsrooms think is important.

What you can expect from us

  • Real ML problems, with models that influence decisions across some of the Nordics’ best-known news brands.

  • Experienced colleagues to learn from, and room to take ownership of your work.

  • Time and space to learn, experiment and share ideas.

The practical bits

  • Location: Oslo, Bergen or Stockholm. Hybrid.

  • Employee terms and benefits follow Schibsted’s standards in your country, and we are happy to go through the details with you in the process.

  • The team is spread across Norway and Sweden, so some days are on video.

  • Working language: English

We welcome applications from people with different experiences and career paths, and we focus on the skills and potential you bring.

Apply

Send your CV and a few lines about a data science or machine learning project you've worked on. What problem were you trying to solve, what was your contribution, and what did you learn?

It doesn't have to be a model you took all the way to production. We're interested in how you think and what you've learned from doing the work.

No long cover letter needed.

We'll keep you informed throughout the process and let you know the outcome of your application.

Deadline: November 6th 2026

Questions? Contact Johanna Haglund Lindqvist, Head of Data Science & Data Engineering.

About Schibsted

Schibsted is the largest news provider in the Nordics, with brands such as VG, Aftonbladet, TV4, MTV, Aftenposten, Svenska Dagbladet and Podme. Every day we inform, engage and entertain millions of people across Sweden, Norway and Finland. Since 1839, trust has been our foundation.

title: Tax Manager
description:
Ready to take your tax career beyond technical advice?

At Schibsted, tax goes beyond compliance. We combine technical expertise with commercial understanding to support business decisions, manage risks and contribute to the Group's strategic priorities.

We are looking for a Tax Manager to join our Group Tax function. Based in Sweden, you will work across the Nordics, supporting our leading media brands in their respective markets. You will take ownership of tax matters, contribute to strategic projects and collaborate with colleagues across Schibsted.

About Schibsted

Schibsted is home to some of the most established and widely used media brands in the Nordics, including Svenska Dagbladet, Aftonbladet, TV4, Aftenposten, VG, E24 and MTV.

Independent journalism is at the heart of what we do. Through trusted news, engaging content and innovative digital services, our brands inform and connect millions of people every day. Combining strong media brands with a commitment to innovation, we continuously explore new ways to engage audiences and develop our products and services.

The opportunity

As Tax Manager, you will work closely with the Head of Tax and play an important role in shaping and developing our Group Tax function.

You will take ownership of Swedish tax matters while contributing to Nordic and international tax initiatives. The role offers a high degree of autonomy, exposure to a broad range of tax disciplines and the opportunity to work on matters that are important to the Group.

What you will do

  • Corporate income tax: Manage Swedish corporate tax matters, including reporting, compliance and tax audits.

  • International tax: Advise on cross-border tax matters, including transfer pricing, Pillar Two and Country-by-Country Reporting.

  • Indirect tax: Advise on VAT matters related to digital products, subscriptions, bundled offerings and cross-border transactions.

  • Strategic projects: Provide tax advice on M&A, reorganisations and commercial initiatives.

  • Business partnering: Collaborate with Finance, Legal and business stakeholders to deliver practical, commercially sound tax advice.

  • Tax technology and processes: Help develop Group-wide tax processes and controls, leveraging AI, automation and digital tools to improve efficiency.

You will work across a broad range of tax topics, but we do not expect you to be an expert in all of them from day one.

Who are we looking for?

We believe the right mindset is just as important as technical expertise.

You have a strong foundation in tax, enjoy solving complex problems and are curious about how businesses operate. You are comfortable taking responsibility, managing projects and collaborating with stakeholders across different functions and countries.

We think you will bring:

  • A university degree in law, economics, business or a related discipline.

  • Relevant experience in corporate taxation, preferably from a Big Four firm, a law firm or an international group.

  • A solid understanding of Swedish corporate taxation, combined with an interest in Nordic and international tax matters.

  • Experience advising multinationals or working on cross-border tax projects.

  • Strong analytical skills and sound commercial judgment, with the ability to translate complex tax matters into practical recommendations.

  • The ability to manage projects, engage stakeholders and drive matters forward independently.

  • Strong communication skills and professional fluency in Swedish and English.

Experience within media, technology, telecommunications or other digital businesses would be particularly relevant.

Above all, we value curiosity, initiative and a pragmatic mindset. We are looking for someone who enjoys learning, challenges assumptions and understands the wider business implications of tax decisions.

An interest in AI, technology and how the tax profession is evolving is something we particularly value.

Why join Schibsted?

Work close to the business. Contribute to commercial and strategic decisions across some of the Nordics' most recognised media brands.

Make a real impact. Join a developing Group Tax function where you can take ownership, influence priorities and help shape how we work.

Broaden your expertise. Work across tax disciplines, countries and business models, with significant autonomy and close collaboration with senior stakeholders.

Shape the future of tax. Help explore how AI, technology and smarter processes can improve the way tax functions operate.

Interested?

If you have a solid tax foundation and an ambition to work closer to the business, we would love to hear from you.

You don't need to tick every box. We are looking for someone with the judgment, drive and potential to grow with the role.

Join us and help shape the future of tax at Schibsted.

title: Senior Data Lead - Product
description:
About the position

Schibsted Media builds news products that more than 6 million people across the Nordics use every day. Data is at the heart of building products that people love, and we are building a modern data foundation that supports smarter personalization, user engagement, and monetization across our media brands.

We are now hiring a Senior Data Lead to join us. This is a new role, created as our data teams have grown and matured. We now want to take the next step towards a shared way of working, with common standards and best practice that hold across domains, disciplines and brands, and we are looking for someone to lead that work.

As Senior Data Lead you work directly alongside our Director of Data, with wide influence across analytics, data engineering and data science. Our Product Data teams span three domains. User covers the user lifecycle, Content covers the lifecycle of the news content we produce, and Performance works directly with our media brands. Your role spans all three, setting shared direction and standards that help teams stay aligned and move faster with data.

What you will do

You will be accountable for Product Data as a discipline, and lead the cross-product data initiatives that no single domain can own.

  • Set the direction. Together with the Director of Data, define technical and analytical direction across our data domains, and be a point of reference for analysts, data engineers and data scientists.

  • Shape how we work. Build our operating model and one shared playbook of standards, guidelines and reusable patterns, covering how data products are owned, documented and kept reliable. You do this together with lead analysts, engineers and product owners, who each drive a practice area such as metrics and KPIs, data products, engineering or experimentation.

  • Lead cross-product initiatives. Lead a small number of data initiatives that span several domains and brands, such as shared KPIs and user segments across our products.

  • Improve how we build with AI. Explore and scale new ways of using AI across data work, from better tools for analysts and engineers to agents, and set the quality bar for AI-produced analysis. Make sure our data is ready to power AI product features.

  • Partner with Schibsted's central Data teams. Work closely with our central Data and AI teams on governance, data architecture and shared standards. Bring in Product's needs and expectations, and turn shared decisions into how we work in Product.

  • Grow senior people. Coach and develop senior and lead individual contributors across all three disciplines, without line management.

What we're looking for:

You bring deep expertise in at least one of analytics, data engineering or data science, and enough fluency in the others to be credible across all three. We don't expect anyone to be an expert in everything below.

At the core, you have

  • 7+ years of experience in analytics, data engineering or data science, including several years in senior or lead roles with influence across teams.

  • Experience building shared ways of working, standards and best practice across several teams.

  • Experience designing metrics and KPIs that hold across brands, products or markets.

  • Strong SQL and data modelling skills, with hands-on experience of dbt and a cloud warehouse such as Snowflake.

  • Strong skills in Python or R.

  • Applied experience using AI and LLM tooling in analytical or engineering work.

  • Clear technical writing, ideally with experience of architecture decision records (ADRs).

  • Strong judgement about scope and priorities. You can decline or redirect work, including valuable work, so that the most important things get done.

Depth in some of these is a strong plus

  • Data mesh and data product practice, such as domain ownership, data contracts, service levels and documentation.

  • Data governance, data quality and privacy under GDPR.

  • Experiment design and causal inference, including quasi-experimental methods and holdouts.

  • ML and AI methods, deep enough to set quality and evaluation standards for others' work.

It's also a plus if you have

  • Fluent Swedish or Norwegian. You will work closely with editorial and brand stakeholders in both markets.

  • Experience from media, or from translating data work for executive and board-level audiences.

We encourage applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and identities to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement. What matters most is your motivation and potential.

Our tech stack:

  • Data platform: AWS, Snowflake

  • Transformation and orchestration: dbt, Airflow

  • Programming and scripting: Python, SQL, R

  • Exploration and delivery: Amplitude, Superset, Streamlit, Kilkaya

  • Tracking and events: Pulse (in-house tracking), Kafka

Who you are

You lead through influence. You build alignment in groups that don't report to you, explain the why behind a standard, and are comfortable holding an outcome while someone else does the work. You write clearly, because much of what you produce has to work without you in the room. And you have good judgement about scope: you make a call, document your reasoning, and say no when something belongs elsewhere.

Why we enjoy working here:

At Schibsted, we value openness, curiosity, and collaboration. You'll be part of a diverse, inclusive workplace that encourages bold thinking and continuous learning. Our work directly supports public interest journalism, and we take that responsibility seriously.

Whether you're enabling better content decisions, driving user personalization, or shaping experimentation at scale, your contributions will help shape the future of digital media in the Nordics.

You will be joining a collaborative, impact-driven team that works across disciplines like technology, product, and editorial. We believe in structured yet flexible ways of working, balancing clear ownership with strong teamwork. Curiosity, openness, and a drive to create value through data are at the heart of how we operate. We support each other, celebrate continuous learning, and are passionate about turning complex challenges into meaningful solutions for our users and brands.

Application process:

Please apply for this position by sharing your CV with us and a letter of motivation. English is our corporate language, but you are welcome to write it in Swedish or Norwegian. Selection of candidates takes place on an ongoing basis during the process.
