#LI-LB

title: Solution Architect
description:
Looking for a workplace for the future?

At Telenor, you own your career. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make the most of your dreams and expertise while contributing to technological innovations that are barely even imagined today. Innovations that we know will change the way we communicate and live our connected lives in the future.

We are now looking for a Solution Architect to join our Strategy & Architecture team in Karlskrona.

How you'll make a difference with us

As a Solution Architect, you'll play a key role in shaping the technology solutions that support Telenor's future business and customer experiences. Working at the intersection of business and technology, you'll help transform complex challenges into secure, scalable, and sustainable solutions.

You'll be part of the Strategy & Architecture team and collaborate closely with business stakeholders, Enterprise Architects, development teams, and external partners. From early discovery and design through implementation, you'll help guide initiatives that modernize our digital landscape and create long-term value for both customers and the business.

In this role, you will:

  • Translate business needs into robust technology solutions

  • Shape solution architecture across complex business and technology domains

  • Drive modernization of our IT and digital landscape

  • Guide teams from concept and design through implementation

  • Balance customer value, business priorities, security, cost, and long-term sustainability

  • Ensure alignment with architecture principles and strategic direction

Your work will contribute to creating simpler, smarter, and more reliable digital experiences, helping our customers stay connected in a safe way.

Are you the one we're looking for?

We need someone who's always on their toes! You have a genuine desire to learn and develop so we can continue to meet our customers' ever-changing needs, today and tomorrow.

You're an architect who enjoys connecting strategy, business, and technology. You understand that the best solutions are not always the most complex ones, and you're comfortable influencing decisions across teams and stakeholder groups.

We believe you bring:

  • Experience designing end-to-end solutions in complex IT environments

  • The ability to communicate architecture and technical decisions in a clear and engaging way

  • Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills

  • A pragmatic mindset with the ability to balance big-picture thinking with attention to detail

  • A university degree or equivalent practical experience

  • Professional proficiency in English

It's a bonus if you also have experience with:

  • Telecommunications and digital services

  • BSS/OSS environments

  • Cloud platforms and cloud-native technologies

  • APIs, integrations, and microservices

  • AI technologies and emerging digital capabilities

  • Security architecture and secure-by-design principles

Most importantly, you're curious, adaptable, and motivated by solving problems, learning new things and helping shape the future of technology at Telenor.

Our promise to you!

We are better together. Here, you'll be part of a family-like and inclusive culture, built on strong shared values and leadership that empowers you with both trust and confidence. We believe in enabling each other to act and make decisions, while always having each other's backs through ups and downs.

We support relationships and societies. Telenor plays a vital role in society, giving your work a greater purpose. Every day, we create value for millions of people and maintain a customer-first approach where human relationships are at the heart of everything we do.

We make room for life. Work from home up to two days a week, if your role allows it. The rest of the time, we create magic together at the office. You also get two "give-me-a-break" days per year for extra time off, and our flexible working hours help you balance your time. We support you through every stage of life with our benefit package, including collective agreements, occupational pensions, wellness allowances, and customized insurance solutions tailored to your needs.

We invite you to a career in motion. Your development is at the center of our culture. We dedicate at least 40 hours per year to deepening your expertise, exploring new areas, and developing your role. Through Telenor Academy and other learning initiatives, you'll have the tools and freedom to advance your career. If you want to broaden your horizons, we are present throughout the Nordics.

Apply today!

Will you take the next step in your career with us? We look forward to your application! We review applicants on an ongoing basis, so don’t wait—reach out today.

If you have any questions or want to know more, feel free to contact the hiring manager Liam Forde at liam.forde@telenor.se. Please note that we cannot accept applications via email.

title: Butikssäljare till Kungsportsplatsen
description:
Letar du efter en arbetsplats för framtiden?

Att besöka en av Telenors butiker ska vara en upplevelse i världsklass! Våra kunder bemöts därför av personal med god kunskap om våra produkter och tjänster. Vi strävar alltid efter att hitta den bästa lösningen för varje kund och göra det komplicerade enkelt i alla lägen. Så letar du efter en arbetsplats där du får vara med och bidra till det viktigaste som finns – relationerna mellan människor? Då är du välkommen till oss på Telenor!

Är du den vi söker?

Vi behöver dig som är på tårna! Du har en genuin vilja att lära och utvecklas så att vi kan möta kunders ständigt föränderliga behov – idag och imorgon. 

Driv och engagemang är något vi värderar högt, och vi ser det som en grund för att skapa resultat och långsiktig framgång. Vi söker dig som har disciplin i ditt arbete – du tar ansvar och ser till att dina uppgifter blir gjorda på ett effektivt sätt. Du ser möjligheter där andra ser hinder och tar initiativ för att skapa de bästa förutsättningarna – både för kunden, teamet och dig själv.

För att söka denna tjänst behöver du ha fyllt 18 år och behärska svenska i både tal och skrift. Du ska även vara student och ha minst 6 månader kvar av dina studier. Det är även meriterande om du har tidigare erfarenhet av kundkontakt, exempelvis inom kundservice eller försäljning, antingen över telefon eller i butik. Har du dessutom grundläggande kunskaper i säljteknik ser vi det som ett stort plus.

Så kommer du göra skillnad hos oss

Som butikssäljare befinner du dig i hjärtat av vår verksamhet – i kundmötet. Att öppna dörrarna till butiken, innebär att komma rakt in i pulsen. Det är här vi hjälper våra kunder att få ett bättre abonnemang, den senaste hårdvaran eller att fixa fakturastrulet. Det handlar helt enkelt om att få bort vardagens störningsmoment så att våra kunder kan fokusera på det viktiga i livet.

  • Ge kundservice i världsklass: Du möter kunderna där de är, och skapa en upplevelse som överträffar förväntningarna.

  • Rådgivning: Genom att kombinera produktkunskap och lyhördhet guidar du kunden till rätt lösningar.

  • Bidra till kampanjer och aktiviteter: Du håller dig uppdaterad om aktuella erbjudanden och bidrar till en trivsam och engagerande butiksmiljö för alla besökare.

  • Hålla butiken i toppskick: I nära samarbete med teamet säkerställer du en trivsam, välorganiserad och inbjudande butiksmiljö.

Våra löften till dig

Vi är bättre tillsammans. Hos oss möts du av en familjär och inkluderande kultur, en stark gemensam värdegrund och ett ledarskap som ger dig frihet och handlingskraft. Vi tror på att ge varandra förtroende och frihet att agera och fatta beslut, samtidigt som vi är där för varandra i med- och motgångar. 

Vi stöttar relationer och samhällen. Telenor är ett samhällsbärande företag och här får ditt arbete ett större syfte. Vi skapar värde för miljoner människor varje dag och har ett kundnära förhållningssätt där mänskliga relationer står i centrum.

Vi ger plats för livet. Vi finns där genom livets alla faser och erbjuder trygghetspaket i form av bl.a. kollektivavtal, tjänstepension, friskvårdsbidrag och möjlighet att skräddarsy försäkringslösningar som passar just dig, för ditt behov här och nu. Som tillsvidareanställd har du dessutom vår förmån "två give-me-a-break-days" per år som ger dig en extra paus med möjlighet till återhämtning och välmående.

Vi bjuder in till en spännande karriärresa. Din utveckling står i centrum och hos oss är lärande en del av kulturen. I butikerna fokuserar vi på att coacha, utveckla och ge dig rätt verktyg för att trivas och växa. Telenor erbjuder både fysiska och digitala utbildningar anpassade för just din utvecklingsresa. Genom Växa, vår utbildningsplattform, och andra lärandeinitiativ får du därmed möjligheten att utvecklas och forma din egen karriär. Majoriteten av våra tjänster tillsätts internt så när du vill vidare väntar möjligheterna här. 

Sök till oss idag       

Vill du ta ditt nästa steg i karriären med oss? Vi ser fram emot din ansökan! Vi träffar kandidater löpande så hör av dig redan idag. Observera att vi inte tar emot ansökningar via mejl.

Bra att känna till

Om du går vidare i rekryteringsprocessen kommer du få göra tre tester som fokuserar på din personlighet och färdigheter. Enligt Telenors policy genomför vi även bakgrundskontroll på slutkandidat i samtliga rekryteringar.

title: Head of Service & Journey
description:
Looking for a workplace for the future?
At Telenor, you own your career. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to make the most of your dreams and expertise while contributing to technological innovations that are barely even imagined today. Innovations that we know will change the map for how we communicate and live our connected lives in the future.

Are you ready to lead and shape the future of IT in a fast-evolving telecom landscape? We are looking for a Head of Service & Journey to lead the development of capabilities supporting B2C customer management, customer communications, service orchestration and customer service capabilities across Telenor's customer lifecycle.

You will guide highly skilled engineering teams operating in a complex integration landscape, balancing business needs, technical evolution and long-term modernization.

How you’ll make a difference with us
As Head of Service & Journey, you will lead two highly specialized engineering teams working at the heart of Telenor’s customer journey and service landscape. Your teams own capabilities such as customer management, customer communications, service orchestration and customer journey management — all central to how we interact with and serve our customers across channels and journeys.

You will play a key role in ensuring that these capabilities and integrations are scalable, resilient and continuously evolving. Together with engineers, architects and business stakeholders, you will drive modernization, strengthen engineering excellence and turn technological opportunities into tangible value for customers and the business.

With a team of approximately 25 colleagues and consultants, you will also ensure the right capability mix and an effective organization that can support both current priorities and future business needs.

Your Responsibilities

  • Strategic Leadership: Align and execute the roadmap for the Service & Journey domain, balancing business priorities with long-term technology modernization and capability development.

  • Team Management & Growth: Lead, develop and inspire highly skilled engineering teams, fostering a culture of technical excellence, accountability, innovation and continuous learning.

  • Operational Excellence: Ensure stable, resilient and secure platforms while continuously improving operational performance, engineering efficiency and customer outcomes.

  • Engineering Excellence & Innovation: Strengthen engineering excellence through modern development practices, automation, AI-assisted ways of working, continuous improvement and technical modernization.

  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner closely with business stakeholders, architects, and technology teams to align business priorities, architectural direction and technical execution.

Are you the one we’re looking for?

You are a curious and confident leader who creates direction, engagement and ownership. You thrive in a rapidly changing environment and have a genuine desire to keep learning and developing, both personally and together with your teams. You lead through trust and clarity, build strong relationships across teams and stakeholders, and make complex topics understandable and actionable.

You combine strategic thinking with pragmatic execution and have the courage to challenge established ways of working when it creates value. With a genuine curiosity for technology, you are comfortable engaging in discussions on areas such as architecture, engineering excellence and AI. You ask the right questions and help your teams navigate complex technical choices with clarity and confidence.

We believe you bring

  • Experience in IT delivery in complex technology environments, with the ability and motivation to lead and develop highly skilled engineering teams.

  • Strong technical foundation, ideally gained through experience in architecture, software engineering or other senior technical roles, with the ability to engage confidently in discussions on modern software development, architecture, integration landscapes and engineering excellence — without needing to be the architect yourself.

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to bridge business, architecture and engineering perspectives.

  • Experience driving modernization, change or continuous improvement, balancing long-term capability building with immediate business needs.

  • A practical understanding of how AI, automation and emerging technologies can create value for teams, customers and the business.

  • Experience working in complex integration landscapes and with enterprise integration platforms is considered an advantage.

Our promise to you

We are better together. Here, you’ll be part of a family-like and inclusive culture, built on strong shared values and leadership that empowers you with both trust and confidence. We believe in enabling each other to act and make decisions, while always having each other’s backs through ups and downs.

We support relationships and societies.Telenor plays a vital role in the society, giving your work a greater purpose. Every day, we create value for millions of people and maintain a customer-first approach where human relationships are at the heart of everything we do.

We make room for life. Work from home up to two days a week, if your role allows it. The rest of the time, we create magic together at the office. Leadership based on trust and flexible working hours helps you balance work and life. We support you through every stage of life with our benefit package, including collective agreements, occupational pensions, wellness allowances, and customized insurance solutions tailored to your needs.

We invite you to a career in motion. Your development is at the center of our culture. We dedicate at least 40 hours per year for you to deepen your expertise, explore new areas, and develop in your role. Through Telenor Academy and other learning initiatives, you’ll have the tools and freedom to advance your career. If you want to broaden your horizons, we are present throughout the Nordics.

Apply today!

Will you take the next step in your career with us? We look forward to your application! We review applicants on an ongoing basis, so don’t wait—reach out today.

If you have any questions or want to know more, feel free to contact the hiring manager Hanna Svanholt, hanna.svanholt@telenor.se. Please note that we cannot accept applications via email.

Good to know

As part of Telenor’s policy, we conduct background checks on final candidates for all recruitments.

title: Butikssäljare till Eskilstuna
description:
Letar du efter en arbetsplats för framtiden?

Att besöka en av Telenors butiker ska vara en upplevelse i världsklass! Våra kunder bemöts därför av personal med god kunskap om våra produkter och tjänster. Vi strävar alltid efter att hitta den bästa lösningen för varje kund och göra det komplicerade enkelt i alla lägen. Så letar du efter en arbetsplats där du får vara med och bidra till det viktigaste som finns – relationerna mellan människor? Då är du välkommen till oss på Telenor!

Är du den vi söker?

Vi behöver dig som är på tårna! Du har en genuin vilja att lära och utvecklas så att vi kan möta kunders ständigt föränderliga behov – idag och imorgon. 

Driv och engagemang är något vi värderar högt, och vi ser det som en grund för att skapa resultat och långsiktig framgång. Vi söker dig som har disciplin i ditt arbete – du tar ansvar och ser till att dina uppgifter blir gjorda på ett effektivt sätt. Du ser möjligheter där andra ser hinder och tar initiativ för att skapa de bästa förutsättningarna – både för kunden, teamet och dig själv.

För att söka denna tjänst behöver du ha fyllt 18 år och behärska svenska i både tal och skrift. Det är även meriterande om du har tidigare erfarenhet av kundkontakt, exempelvis inom kundservice eller försäljning, antingen över telefon eller i butik. Har du dessutom grundläggande kunskaper i säljteknik ser vi det som ett stort plus.

Så kommer du göra skillnad hos oss

Som butikssäljare befinner du dig i hjärtat av vår verksamhet – i kundmötet. Att öppna dörrarna till butiken, innebär att komma rakt in i pulsen. Det är här vi hjälper våra kunder att få ett bättre abonnemang, den senaste hårdvaran eller att fixa fakturastrulet. Det handlar helt enkelt om att få bort vardagens störningsmoment så att våra kunder kan fokusera på det viktiga i livet.

  • Ge kundservice i världsklass: Du möter kunderna där de är, och skapa en upplevelse som överträffar förväntningarna.

  • Rådgivning: Genom att kombinera produktkunskap och lyhördhet guidar du kunden till rätt lösningar.

  • Bidra till kampanjer och aktiviteter: Du håller dig uppdaterad om aktuella erbjudanden och bidrar till en trivsam och engagerande butiksmiljö för alla besökare.

  • Hålla butiken i toppskick: I nära samarbete med teamet säkerställer du en trivsam, välorganiserad och inbjudande butiksmiljö.

Våra löften till dig

Vi är bättre tillsammans. Hos oss möts du av en familjär och inkluderande kultur, en stark gemensam värdegrund och ett ledarskap som ger dig frihet och handlingskraft. Vi tror på att ge varandra förtroende och frihet att agera och fatta beslut, samtidigt som vi är där för varandra i med- och motgångar. 

Vi stöttar relationer och samhällen. Telenor är ett samhällsbärande företag och här får ditt arbete ett större syfte. Vi skapar värde för miljoner människor varje dag och har ett kundnära förhållningssätt där mänskliga relationer står i centrum.

Vi ger plats för livet. Vi finns där genom livets alla faser och erbjuder trygghetspaket i form av bl.a. kollektivavtal, tjänstepension, friskvårdsbidrag och möjlighet att skräddarsy försäkringslösningar som passar just dig, för ditt behov här och nu. Som tillsvidareanställd har du dessutom vår förmån "två give-me-a-break-days" per år som ger dig en extra paus med möjlighet till återhämtning och välmående.

Vi bjuder in till en spännande karriärresa. Din utveckling står i centrum och hos oss är lärande en del av kulturen. I butikerna fokuserar vi på att coacha, utveckla och ge dig rätt verktyg för att trivas och växa. Telenor erbjuder både fysiska och digitala utbildningar anpassade för just din utvecklingsresa. Genom Växa, vår utbildningsplattform, och andra lärandeinitiativ får du därmed möjligheten att utvecklas och forma din egen karriär. Majoriteten av våra tjänster tillsätts internt så när du vill vidare väntar möjligheterna här. 

Sök till oss idag       

Vill du ta ditt nästa steg i karriären med oss? Vi ser fram emot din ansökan! Vi träffar kandidater löpande så hör av dig redan idag. Observera att vi inte tar emot ansökningar via mejl.

title: Lead AI Engineer
description:
Cambio is one of the Nordics' leading suppliers in e-health with a comprehensive offering for the entire health and care chain. Our e-health solutions supports health care professionals in their daily work and offer patients safer and more easily accessible care. We are proud to be an important part of Swedish healthcare. We are growing continuously and now have about 1000 employees in several countries.

The position
Imagine being able to improve how an entire company works through AI.

As AI Enablement Lead, you will help teams across Cambio identify opportunities, solve real business problems and turn ideas into working AI solutions that save time, improve quality and create measurable business value.

You will be part of our virtual AI engineering team; an internal AI acceleration team focused on helping nearly 1,000 colleagues work smarter through practical AI solutions. From building agents and automations to supporting Product Engineers and scaling successful initiatives, you will play a key role in shaping how AI is adopted across Cambio.

This is a hands-on builder role. You are expected to create solutions, not just talk about them.

What You'll Be Doing

Build

  • Prototype and build AI agents, automations, internal applications and workflows.

  • Work directly with users to turn real problems into working solutions.

  • Use Microsoft 365, Copilot and modern AI technologies to rapidly test, iterate and deploy solutions.

  • Create reusable components and patterns that accelerate future development.

Drive

  • Own and shape the pipeline of AI opportunities across Cambio.

  • Prioritize initiatives, support Product Engineers and remove blockers.

  • Ensure delivery remains focused on measurable business value.

Enable

  • Help teams identify opportunities where AI can improve everyday work.

  • Run workshops, demos and coaching sessions that drive adoption.

  • Capture and share proven patterns, solutions and best practices.

Scale

  • Identify solutions with broader potential across Cambio.

  • Partner with the AI Platform Team to turn successful initiatives into scalable capabilities.

  • Feed recurring needs and learnings back into the platform roadmap.

How You'll Work

You will work in a highly iterative way:

Discover → Build → Test → Adopt → Measure → Scale

One day you might be building an AI agent with a business team, the next supporting Product Engineers or helping scale a successful solution across the organization.

This role sits at the intersection of product, engineering, enablement and operations.

About you

  • Builder: You enjoy turning ideas into working solutions and getting them into the hands of users.

  • AI-native: AI is already a core part of how you solve problems and create value.

  • Technically capable: You are comfortable working with code, APIs, automation, agents and modern AI tooling.

  • Business-minded: You care about solving real problems and delivering measurable outcomes.

  • Influential: You can work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and help drive adoption.

Technical Experience

We believe you have experience in several of the following areas:

  • 5+ years of modern software development.

  • 2+ years of building AI-powered solutions, agents, automations or copilots.

  • Experience with Microsoft technologies such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, Microsoft Graph, Entra ID, Power Platform or Azure AI services.

  • Experience integrating systems through APIs and building workflow automations.

  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools in day-to-day software development.

  • Experience taking solutions from prototype to production and adoption.

  • Experience with one or more modern programming languages such as Python, C#, Java, JavaScript or TypeScript


Place of employment: Stockholm eller Linköping

Scope: Full-time, hybrid work model (three days per week in-office)

Form of employment: Permanent employment, 6 months trial period

Additional Information: The role involves access to sensitive information, therefore a background check will be conducted on the final candidate.

We review applications and conduct interviews on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible via the link.

We look forward to receiving your application!

CAMBIO- FOR A HEALTHIER TOMORROW

Welcome to a company where healthcare is improved every day. Here you will work with leading technology in a collaborative, trusting and empowering environment where your contribution will be appreciated and celebrated. In our caring culture you will have the opportunity to pursue different paths of professional growth. Seize the opportunity to do the most important work of your life. Read more about us here!


A healthier tomorrow also means taking care of those who make it possible -explore our employee benefits

Learn more about our recruitment process here

Are you interested in Cambio but you don’t feel that this position is the perfect match? Check out our other open positions at our career site.

title: Senior Fullstack Developer to MittVaccin
description:
Cambio is one of the Nordics' leading suppliers in e-health with a comprehensive offering for the entire health and care chain. Our e-health solutions supports health care professionals in their daily work and offer patients safer and more easily accessible care. We are proud to be an important part of Swedish healthcare. We are growing continuously and now have about 1000 employees in several countries.

Since 2012, MittVaccin has been a pioneer in digital vaccination services for residents and healthcare providers across Sweden. As part of Cambio since 2020, we continue to drive innovation that improves access to vaccinations and supports safe, efficient vaccination management. Today, MittVaccin is Sweden’s leading vaccination platform, trusted by 14 regions, 100+ municipalities, and 400+ healthcare providers nationwide. Since 2026, we have also expanded into Finland, marking the beginning of our international growth journey.

title: Head of Credit Data
description:
Ready to shape the data foundation that every credit decision at NOBA rests on? As Head of Credit Data, you’ll decide what data we buy, what we build and what good looks like – so that scorecards, credit rules, analytics and AI tools run on the best input. It’s a role with real weight, and a rare chance to work on what may be the largest credit-relevant dataset in the Nordics.


About the role:
We are Credit & Analytics, the team behind every credit decision across all our markets and brands – the logic, process, software and analytics that handle about 25 million applications per year. Credit data is the raw material for all of it, from scorecards and pricing to our AI tools. We’re rewiring how we work, and we need someone exceptional to own the data side of that journey. As Head of Credit Data, you own the data that powers credit granting: which sources we use, what we require of them, what they cost and how they’re made available. You sit between the credit business and our data engineers, translating between the two.

Your main responsibilities include:

  • Setting the requirements for, and structure of, our credit data – quality, coverage, lineage and timeliness – so it can be used for scorecards, credit rules, analytics and AI tools, with a clear view of what good looks like

  • Helping teams across NOBA further increase the return on our data

  • Owning our agreements with credit bureaus and external data providers across multiple countries, with overall responsibility for optimising our Credit Information Costs, a budget of around 100 MSEK

  • Working closely with the credit business to prioritise what matters most, and turning that into concrete deliveries for the data engineering team

  • Providing strategic leadership for the NOBA Credit Data function and driving the development of its people, capabilities and ways of working

Who we’re looking for
You’re analytical and structured, with a clear view of what good looks like and the drive to get there. You find novel solutions to complex problems, build strong relationships and listen to turn ambiguous asks into precise requirements. Your satisfaction comes from moving the needle.

On top of this, we’re looking for you who have:

  • An M.Sc. or equivalent from a demanding field, with university-level mathematics and strong analytical judgment

  • Expert-level knowledge of the Nordic credit data market, with hands-on experience of bureau datasets for prediction – ideally the full process of scanning, acquiring, negotiating and implementing credit-relevant data, then building models and tracking performance

  • Senior experience in banking and/or consumer credit, with a deep understanding of how credit data feeds models, rules and analytics

  • Proven software development skills, including managing larger software projects end to end, and advanced use of AI development tools

  • Experience driving initiatives in complex stakeholder environments, bridging business and engineering, and communicating clearly with both technical and senior audiences

We’re early in rewiring how credit is underwritten with modern data and AI tooling, so this is a chance to set the standard rather than inherit one. If you want to create something truly outstanding at the core of banking, we’d love to hear from you.


In addition to this, it is important to us that you recognize yourself in our values: we are wholehearted, we collaborate and we take the lead.

title: Finsktalande Customer Advisor till Privatlån - Customer Onboarding (Deltid)
description:
Vill du göra skillnad för människor i en av de viktigaste stunderna i deras ekonomiska vardag? Nu söker vi en Finsktalande Customer Advisor på deltid till vårt Customer Onboarding-team på Privatlåneavdelningen!

Konvertering & kundvärde – ditt fokus

I den här rollen ser du en tydlig koppling mellan ditt arbete och resultatet. Du hjälper kunden vidare från intresse till beviljat lån – genom service, tydlighet och trygghet – så att kunden känner sig säker i sitt beslut. Varje samtal är en chans att göra skillnad.

Om rollen:

Som Customer Advisor i vårt Customer Onboarding-team har du en central roll i kundens resa genom hela låneprocessen – från första kontakt till eventuellt signerat avtal och utbetalning. Du arbetar mot den finska marknaden och är en viktig del av en avdelning på cirka 50 medarbetare som tillsammans stöttar potentiella kunder i Sverige, Norge och Finland. På Privatlån omges du av kompetenta kollegor, en fin gemenskap och ett stöttande ledarskap.

I din vardag har du daglig telefonkontakt med potentiella kunder, både genom inkommande samtal från personer som vill veta mer om sina möjligheter, och genom utgående samtal till kunder med pågående ansökningar. Du möter kundens intresse och omsätter det till konkreta nästa steg, så att fler känner sig trygga att gå vidare från ansökan till beslut.

En del av arbetet handlar om att följa upp ärenden längs vägen, du hör av dig till kunder som ännu inte signerat sitt avtal, hjälper de som behöver komplettera sin ansökan, och ser till att varje kund förstår vilka alternativ och nästa steg som gäller för just dem. På så sätt bidrar du direkt till att fler ansökningar behandlas och fler avtal signeras. Utöver telefonkontakten hanterar du även kunddialoger via mejl, och du samarbetar löpande med interna funktioner för att driva ärenden framåt och lösa eventuella hinder i processen.

Vi söker dig som:

  • Har arbetat inom service, till exempel inom butik, restaurang, resebolag, telefonarbete, försäljning eller liknande – resten lär vi dig!

  • Är nyfiken och har ett genuint intresse för att lära dig branschen

  • Kan arbeta deltid i minst 1 år och har en annan huvudsaklig sysselsättning om minst 50 % under denna tid

  • Talar och skriver obehindrat på finska, samt har god förståelse för engelska och svenska

title: Finnish Speaking Customer Advisor to Collections (Part-time)
description:
Please note that we are not able to hire people that live in Finland. To be able to work with us, you need to be located in the Stockholm area, as the office is our main place to work.

We are now looking for new part time colleagues, as we call "temps", to Pre-Collections. Pre-Collections is an outbound-focused role where you will primarily contact customers who, for various reasons, have fallen behind on their payments. In some cases, there are simple solutions, while in others, you will need to work with the customer to develop a long-term payment plan. You will also handle some inbound calls from customers who reach out to us. Alongside the calls, there is some administrative work, but the role itself is phone-based, which is why we are looking for someone who enjoys customer interaction and sees every conversation as an opportunity to help!📞

To succeed in this role, it is important that you are engaged and proactive - both in customer interactions and in your own development. We value team members who actively contribute to discussions and meetings, even in situations where they may not yet have the deepest expertise. 💡

We operate in a highly regulated industry, and it is crucial that you understand the responsibility that comes with working at a bank, especially in adhering to the regulatory frameworks we must follow. Examples of relevant regulations include GDPR, banking secrecy, AML (Anti-Money Laundering) regulations, and identity verification requirements. We must also be mindful of how we communicate with our customers, both verbally and in writing. 📓✔️🖊️

This position starts with a full-time introduction for three weeks in the office. In order for you to have good conditions to start working, attendance as high as possible is required during these two weeks. After the two weeks, while you are still in training, the shifts will be scheduled during daytime in the office. When you can work independently, you will also have the option to work from home.

We are looking for you who:

  • Have worked with customer service or people

  • Speaks and writes fluently in Finnish and English

  • Can and want to work part-time for at least 1 year (hopefully longer!)

Shifts:
Your shifts will mostly be scheduled during the 30th-5th and 15th-17th every month.

To thrive and perform well in the role, we believe that you need to be:

  • Service-oriented & communicative: You have the ability to listen and understand different people’s needs while also having the confidence to set clear expectations in conversations. 🌱

  • Results-driven: You are motivated by achieving results and goals, such as customer satisfaction. 🏆

  • Flexible: You can adapt to different situations that arise at work and excel at prioritizing tasks. 🤸‍♀️

title: System Specialist - Core Banking
description:
NOBA is building a new core banking system, and we're looking for the expert who can help us get it right. As System Specialist, you take a key role in this brand-new build, with real ownership and influence over how our financial products work from the inside. Your experience will make a visible impact.

The team Projects and Product Development is a driving force for change at NOBA. We optimize processes and system support across the organization, with a long-term view and stable solutions in mind. So far we've built onboarding for mortgages and personal loans. Now we're taking on our first own core system, working side by side with the business and our software engineering team.

About the role
You will own the requirements for one of the core systems behind NOBA's financial products, sitting between business, legal and development. You turn complex rules, regulations and business needs into clear specifications, and drive them through to implementation, so our solutions are stable and compliant.

In your role, you will:

  • Be the driving force in keeping our core solutions for financial products optimized

  • Analyze complex processes, rules and regulations across the customer life cycle, including new regulations such as CCD2

  • Talk to stakeholders to make sure every aspect is considered when specifying a change

  • Translate business and regulatory requirements into clear, actionable system specifications and the documentation that goes with them

  • Explain complex flows in a way that works for both developers and the business

  • Drive the implementation of changes in the core systems together with development and business teams

  • Make sure our system solutions are stable, compliant and support efficient end-to-end processes

Who we're looking for
You're an accountable team player who stays calm when things get complex. You take the lead through influence rather than title, driving things forward and owning your delivery. You communicate clearly, build trust across teams, share your knowledge generously and adapt when priorities shift.

In addition to this, we're looking for someone who:

  • Has detailed knowledge of at least one commercial financial product, such as mortgages, personal loans, credit cards or savings accounts, and its processes

  • Has deep and broad knowledge of what happens "under the hood" in a core banking system, for example data models, transaction life cycle, integrations and APIs, and batch versus real-time processing

  • Can translate business and regulatory requirements into concrete system specifications and write clear requirement documentation

  • Knows the regulations related to personal loans and deposits

  • Has a systematic approach to implementing change, and strong logical and systems thinking

  • Has experience from banking and finance, fintech or a system vendor

  • Speaks Swedish and English (Danish, Norwegian, Finnish or German is a plus)



In addition to this, it is important to us that you recognize yourself in our values: we are wholehearted, we collaborate and we take the lead.

title: Identity & Access Management Lead
description:
Lead the team. Own the strategy. Shape how a bank manages access. Here, you'll lead our IAM team and own identity as a strategic discipline, setting the direction while still diving into the details. Your work will strengthen both our security and our compliance as a bank, and you'll influence how we handle access for many years to come.

We are IT Operations at NOBA, the team that keeps the bank's IT environment running smoothly, securely and reliably every day. Identity and access touch nearly every part of IT, so we work closely with colleagues across the organisation. Together, we make sure the right people have the right access at the right time, and that we meet the requirements placed on us as a bank.

About the role:
As Identity & Access Management Lead, you'll combine people leadership with strategic ownership: you set direction, own outcomes and dive into the detail when needed. You'll lead our IAM team and be the go-to person for identity across the organisation. You will be responsible for:

  • Leading, coaching and developing the IAM team, creating an environment where people grow and do their best work

  • Setting the team's priorities, ways of working and balance between strategic initiatives and day-to-day operations

  • The end-to-end identity lifecycle: onboarding, role changes, offboarding and everything that keeps access accurate and timely

  • The roadmap for making Microsoft Entra ID our authoritative identity source, phasing out reliance on on-premises Active Directory and improving it along the way

  • Access governance, including access reviews and privileged access management

  • SSO strategy and coverage across our SaaS and internal application landscape

  • Identity's role in our compliance obligations, including DORA-related reporting and audit readiness

  • Being the leading authority on identity and access across the organisation

Who we're looking for:
You enjoy owning a vision and a roadmap, not just working through tickets. You bring out the best in others, collaborate confidently across teams, love automating away manual work and take the lead when something needs to improve.

In addition, we're looking for you who:

  • Have experience leading people or teams, formally or as a technical lead

  • Have solid experience in IAM, ideally with Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD in a hybrid identity environment

  • Understand access management and audit requirements in a regulated environment

  • Have experience with automation, Lifecycle Workflows, PIM or equivalent

  • Have a genuine interest in reducing manual work

  • Are comfortable working cross-functionally, since identity touches nearly every other domain within IT

  • Have experience from financial services (a plus)

In addition to this, it is important to us that you recognize yourself in our values: we are wholehearted, we collaborate and we take the lead.

title: Låneförvaltare till Svensk Hypotekspension
description:
Trivs du med siffror, struktur och att säkerställa hög kvalitet i varje detalj? Som låneförvaltare inom hypotekslån med kapitalfrigöringskredit får du en central roll där du kombinerar analytiskt tänkande med kundfokus. Du ansvarar för att våra lån hanteras korrekt bidrar till en effektiv och tillförlitlig låneförvaltning.

Svensk Hypotekspension är specialiserat på hypotekspension - en kapitalfrigöringskredit som låter personer över 60 år att låna med bostaden som säkerhet utan att amortera eller betala ränta löpande. På så vis kan kunden frigöra pengar ur sitt hem utan att sälja och flytta, och utan att vardagsekonomin påverkas.

Om rollen:
Som låneförvaltare ansvarar du för den löpande förvaltningen och administrationen av in- och utbetalningar, där noggrannhet och ett gott sifferhuvud är avgörande. Din vardag är omväxlande och består av förbereda och genomföra dagliga utbetalningar av beviljade lån med rätt säkerhet på plats, hantera pantbrev och avslut av lån. Du sköter registervård av lånereskontran, gör löpande avstämningar och kontrollerar att siffrorna stämmer.

Rollen kombinerar det noggranna sifferarbetet med en god servicekänsla. Du ska motiveras av administrativa arbetsuppgifter. En del av din tid lägger du på att besvara frågor från kunder, mäklare och andra banker via telefon och e-post. Du hanterar allt från transaktioner kopplade till nya kunder till befintliga kunders skulder och lån, och säkerställer att rätt information finns på plats när det krävs.


Huvudsakliga uppgifter:

  • Ansvara för den löpande förvaltningen och administrationen av bolån med säkerhet i fastighet eller bostadsrätt.

  • Säkerställa en korrekt och effektiv hantering av låneärenden, från utbetalning till avslut.

  • Ge god service och vägledning till våra kunder

  • Hantera och följa upp förändringar i låneengagemang samt säkerställa att arbetet utförs i enlighet med gällande regelverk, interna riktlinjer och processer.

Vi söker dig som har:

  • Har arbetat med privatlån, bolån eller andra krediter

  • Har erfarenhet av service, administrativt arbete och arbete via telefon

  • Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift

Vi ser det som positivt om du har arbetat med pantbrev och säkerheter.

För att trivas och prestera väl i rollen tror vi att du behöver vara:
En lagspelare som är noggrann med öga för detaljer, du vet att det är just precisionen som gör skillnad och du trivs i en roll där ditt kvalitetsfokus får komma till sin fulla rätt. Du är analytisk och får energi av siffror; du har intresse för transaktionsflöden, gör avstämningar och har en känsla för när något behöver en extra titt. Du är även kundfokuserad och tycker om mötet med människor. Du är också strukturerad skapar du enkelt ordning och överblick över ditt arbete och trivs med administrativa arbetsuppgifter.

Utöver detta är det viktigt för oss att du känner igen dig i våra värderingar: vi är helhjärtade, vi samarbetar och vi tar ledningen

title: Head of Credit Underwriting and Decision Analytics Nordax
description:
Ready to take on a role at the absolute core of banking, where your decisions shape how credit is assessed and lending decisions are made? As Head of Credit Underwriting and Decision Analytics, you'll balance pricing, risk, compliance and strategy while working closely with senior stakeholders. It's a role with real weight – and a rare opportunity to leave your mark on how we underwrite credit for the future.

We are the team behind every credit decision made across our markets. Our team includes lead analysts in each market and a broader analytics group of junior and senior analysts and scorecard developers. We're currently rewiring how we work, exploring new technologies to strengthen our underwriting.

About the role

As Head of Credit Underwriting and Decision Analytics, you'll lead the team responsible for our credit process design and performance, working across pricing, risk and compliance. You'll be a key voice among senior stakeholders, driving the direction of underwriting in a complex, ever-changing environment.

Your main responsibilities include:

  • Collaborating with senior stakeholders across the business to align priorities

Who we're looking for

We're looking for someone analytical who thrives on solving complex problems and cutting through ambiguity. You build strong relationships and listen closely to understand different perspectives, and you're motivated by high-impact work where you help your team find novel ways forward.

On top of this, we're looking for someone who:

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
We’re looking for a Cloud Engineer who enjoys working in the space where developers and infrastructure meet. Here, you’ll spend your time automating the mundane, architecting the complex, and scaling the future of our Azure AI and OpenAI offerings. This role is for you if you find more joy in writing a PowerShell script to solve a recurring app error than in managing a cluster’s networking.

This is a code-centric role where infrastructure is treated as a software product. Everything you build is versioned, reviewed, tested, and continuously improved. Our goal is to reduce repetitive work and create the “Golden Paths” that let developers and AI teams deploy quickly, securely, and reliably. 

About the role:
As a Cloud Engineer, you’ll help build and grow our Azure-based platform. You’ll own the design, automation, and delivery of modular cloud infrastructure, ensuring it’s resilient, scalable, and easy for teams to use. Your work will reduce friction, remove unnecessary steps, and make it simple for developers and data teams to focus on building features instead of worrying about infrastructure.

What you’ll do: 

  • Build the "Golden Path" Pipelines: You won't just "run" pipelines; you will architect them. You’ll design and maintain CI/CD templates (YAML-based) that standardize how our applications are built, tested, and deployed. Your goal is to make the path from code-complete to production-ready as invisible and frictionless as possible for our developers.

  • Automated Application Remediation: We don't believe in manual maintenance. You will use PowerShell and Azure DevOps to build automated pipelines for things like patching the container OS, reporting on deviations and self healing infrastructure

  • Infrastructure as Versioned Code: You’ll design and implement modular Azure infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (Bicep), following the Azure Well-Architected Framework for reliability, performance, and cost.

We are looking for you who have:

  • Expert-level PowerShell skills: We operate in an environment where automation is built on PowerShell first. (Bash & Python are secondary)

  • Proven experience with Azure Bicep: You should be comfortable treating infrastructure as a software product, versioning, testing and modularizing Bicep code.

  • Developer-centric approach: You don't need to be a fullstack developer, but you need to understand application logic enough to automate patching, troubleshoot database connections, and optimize application performance within the cloud.

  • Fluency in English (written and spoken).

You’ll be comfortable owning tasks end to end and making technical decisions independently within the areas listed above. Ideally, you have some years of hands-on experience with Azure, containers, and CI/CD pipelines, but we care more about what you can do and that you enjoy the field, rather than the exact number of years. 

It's positive if you have: 

  • Active Azure certifications such as AZ-400 (DevOps Engineer), AZ-305 (Solutions Architect), AZ-204 (Developer Associate)

  • Experience from regulated or security-conscious environments is a plus 

In addition to this, it is important to us that you recognize yourself in our values: we are wholehearted, we collaborate and we take the lead.

title: Credit Risk Analyst
description:
Every great credit decision starts with a question: can we trust this number? Our Credit Analytics team spends its days answering it, and we're looking for a Credit Risk Analyst to help us do it even better.

Get an idea of the role

Picture your first few weeks. You sit down with a scorecard that's been running in production for a while, and together with a colleague you start asking how it's really performing. Is it still ranking customers well? Has the portfolio shifted underneath it? You dig in, find the answer, and then comes the part we care about most: turning that analysis into something a colleague or stakeholder can read, understand, and act on.

That's the rhythm of the work. You'll develop, validate, and monitor credit scorecards, and you'll explain what they tell us in plain, clear language. Along the way, you'll help us improve how we work: documenting and structuring our code, sharing analyses properly, and using version control and reproducible workflows so that nothing lives only on one person's laptop. Because good teams never stand still, you'll also get to explore new methods and tools and test them honestly against the approach we use today.

Requirements for the role

You've spent a few years in credit risk, analytics, or a similar quantitative role, and you're comfortable in Python and SQL. If you also know SAS, that's a welcome bonus. Your background might be a degree in statistics, mathematics, economics, data science, or a related field, or it might be an experience that taught you the same things.

More than any single skill, we're looking for curiosity, and a habit of explaining your work so that others can follow it. If you've used Git and code review, or you know your way around model validation and documentation requirements, you'll feel at home quickly. If not, you'll learn.

What it's like to work here

You'll be joining a team of four senior analysts, led by Dácil Hernández, who genuinely enjoy sharing what they know. Mentoring isn't an afterthought here; colleagues invest real time in it. You won't be expected to know everything on day one. Questions are welcome, and from early on you'll have real ownership of your work.

The challenges are varied too, with credit risk questions spanning multiple Nordic markets.
